**Finding: compliant (no redline).**

Section 22 sits at the **preferred** AUDIT position on every element:

| Element | Location |
|---|---|
| Once per 12 months | § 22.1 |
| 30 days' prior written notice | § 22.1 |
| Business hours | § 22.1 |
| Independent auditor | § 22.1 |
| Auditor bound by confidentiality | § 22.1 |
| Off-site where practicable | § 22.1 |
| Vendor cost unless >5% underpayment | § 22.2 |
| No direct access to Customer systems | § 22.2 |

Supporting protections beyond the checklist (audit findings are Customer Confidential Information, use limited to enforcement, copy of final report, shortfall payment resolves the issue) further favour us. Section 23 is a heading with no operative text, and no other inspection, verification, monitoring, or records right binds Juniper Ridge. Nothing to redline.
